Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations sustain strong momentum despite elevated spot levels.

Silver.note: Outperformance driven by dual industrial and monetary demand amid persistent physical market deficits.

Copper.note: Smelter treatment charges at record lows indicate severe concentrate tightness supporting refined prices.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and nuclear renaissance support ongoing long-term contract price increases.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new projects and slowing EV demand growth pressure producer margins.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply growth and LFP battery substitution cap near-term price upside.

Zinc.note: Recent mine closures and depleted exchange inventories tighten the physical market despite strong rally.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets infrastructure stimulus, capping upside from current levels.

Coal.note: Peaking global thermal demand and high seaborne supply limit long-term price expansion.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls and weak EV motor demand create near-term pricing uncertainty.

Manganese.note: South African logistics constraints tighten supply against steady global steel demand.

PGM.note: Weak global auto production and ongoing platinum-palladium substitution weigh on sentiment.

Potash.note: Normalizing Russian and Belarusian supply balances steady agricultural demand, keeping prices neutral.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and strong green energy transition demand tighten the primary metal market.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to iron ore, copper, and coal provides resilient cash flows and downside protection.
